attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps from doxologia's bare line, and the Greek entry gives her what the Romanian did not: a husband, a company and a death. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. **The entry enumerates ten named people and she is the second of them; the other nine are drafted as new folders in `el-12-18-1`, and she relates them and Sebastian.** saint.gr dates the company by the persecution, «κατά τον διωγμό που κίνησε ο Διοκλητιανός (284 - 304 μ.Χ.)», which is recorded in `dates` for a folder that held none, and gives her end exactly: she and her husband Nikostratos died of suffocation, hung upside down with a hearth of fire built below them so that the smoke should go into their faces. It names no city, so no coordinate is proposed, and it prints no hymn; the day's apolytikion stands on Sebastian's page and names him.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 31.12.2025 (18. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Севастијан и други с њим.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. A ROW UNDER A COMPANY TAIL — «и други с њим» — the ruling being set out in full in the `sebastian-of-rome` row of this same reading; it is an author question. The body names her and the corpus already keeps her on this same menologion 18/12 from the Greek and the Romanian. NO `sr` NAME FORM: the heading holds one personal name and it is Sebastian’s; «Зоа» is a body name. `types`, `dates`, `locations` and `related` all UNTOUCHED. SHE IS NEITHER OF THE OTHER TWO ZOE FOLDERS: `zoe-of-bethlehem` and `zoe-wife-of-hesperus` both already carry venerated Serbian rows, on the Julian 13 February and the Julian 2 May, and neither is a jailer’s wife at Rome. WHAT THE BOOK SAYS OF HER, and it is the fullest thing it says of any of the companions: that she was the wife of NICOSTRATUS THE JAILER and had been DUMB SIX YEARS; that Sebastian healed her of it and brought her and the whole house of Nicostratus to baptism; that SHE SUFFERED FIRST OF THEM ALL — «Од њих прво пострада света Зоа» — being taken AT THE TOMB OF THE APOSTLE PETER where she was praying to God, and after torture thrown into the river Tiber. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: saint.gr dates the whole company by the persecution: «Όλοι μαρτύρησαν κατά τον διωγμό που κίνησε ο Διοκλητιανός (284 - 304 μ.Χ.) εναντίον των χριστιανών». No year of birth is given and no year within the reign. The folder held no dates before this reading.
